## Runtime units

| Unit | Lane | Deploy |
|---|---|---|
| `raimovdental` | `docs/projects/raimovdental/` | per raimovdental runtime and release SSOT |

CAESTHETIC, ELITE DENTAL and future clinics remain knowledge/strategy entities until separate runtime roots are explicitly approved in registry.

## Allowed paths

- `docs/projects/healthcare-ecosystem/**`
- `docs/ssot/RAIMOV*.md`, `docs/ssot/EXPERT_DENTAL*.md`, `docs/ssot/ELITE_DENTAL*.md`
- `docs/raimov/**`, `docs/copy/raimov/**`, `docs/legal/raimov/**`, `docs/audits/raimov/**`, `docs/research/raimov/**`
- `research/raimov-profile/**`
- `site-raimovdental/**` only when the task explicitly targets runtime

## Current strategy boundary

- RAIMOV DENTAL is the website master brand.
- Private Atabek review comes first.
- Public hierarchy: investor in directly controlled clinics → doctors/Academy → patient later.
- Replacement v1 is RU-only.
- Medical tourism to Bishkek is excluded from the replacement.
- Investor CTA requires legal Gate 4 and remains a strategic conversation only.

## Bans

- No patient records, medical files, raw PHI, KYC, private investor documents or secrets in git.
- No public financial offer, return, share or terms without counsel approval.
- No claims that System, Academy, network, new clinics or international practice already operate when planned.
- No paid scale-up before funnel/CRM/SLA/capacity gates.
- No invented runtime roots for CAESTHETIC, ELITE DENTAL or future clinics without registry update.
- No mass page generation before Website Studio Gate 4.

## Definition of Done

- Correct domain and runtime authority used.
- Evidence-backed, medically reviewed and legally gated public claims only.
- Website Studio Guard, project check and repo check pass.
- Runtime changes include build, tests, route smoke and rollback evidence; documentation-only strategy changes do not deploy.
